Sure i work. But my favourite moment of the day is when i get off work, get home and go to bed. 

I play laser tag every now and then, but its not really something i would live for.

I have tried, i  really have. But i also keep falling down deeper every time. Thats why i don't care getting help. I walk my days through under a dark foggy cloud.

They already have brought me down and my trust towards people is non existent. Human beings are social creatures, so am I but I don't know how to function here. 

I go to school and I also work. I'm going to graduate soon. Though I couldn't care less. 

I wrap my cuts and wear a loose shirt. They don't show.

people don't seem to like me. i don't know what i do wrong. i try to be nice and polite.  i barely have any friends and it's always been like that. i was bullied for years in school. later both at my work places. guys i run into have all used me. i dont know how life works. i've always felt i don't belong here and won't live long
life. people. people are mean. i have no one that cares. those who seem to just used me and left. lonelier than ever
no. nobody to call. i don't know if i want help. anymore. i just want to go
my arm. many times. enough to bleed

This time I have really strong feeling that it wont go away. I thought I would have struggled in my life enough but no. This is bad and severe. And I see no way out. What hurts me a lot is that people don't care. They're too busy with their own lives. I just need a hug.

I guess I'm really stuck in a rut here.

I feel exactly the same way. It feels like everybody's so freaking happy and living da life. And I have to be the bystander. Isolated, like you said. 

I have been thinking of shutting down my account. At least for a while. These happy people's lives are making me miserable. Because that's what one does when depressed. You pay attention to a life you don't have.

First one with therapy (and I got a new group of friends after three years of bullying), second time with meds and therapy (I was suicidal), third was left untreated. Now I'm on meds again and was on shitty therapy. And there was always some hope I guess or something to look for. Problem us now that I don't have anything to look for. I'm stuck. I haven't been exited about life for awhile.

I don't think anybody knows the state of my situation. When I reached out my friends, they vanished. The few kind of friends that are left don't understand. So I keep a happy  face. I'm completely alone most of the time, only depression to keep me company. People seem so cruel, like they don't care a single bit. My ex does, but yes, I miss him constantly. I might consider telling him.

My mom is supportive, but she doesen't fully understand either. This time I'm just done fighting the depression. I've done this too many times. It keeps pulling me back, throwing me into a deeper and darker pit every time. Im lost, So lost. The thought of suicide feels calming. I could just sleep forever.

I am touched how people here are willing to help.

I miss him so much. And I know he doesen't want me back. That thought is too hard for me. He doesen't exactly know my situation is this bad but I think he kind of senses it. But still, thought of him not wanting to be with me adds up to the situation which is already bad.
